title: Amherst History Museum

services.name: Upcoming Walking Tours
services.desc: Explore Amherst’s historic West Cemetery through the lens of Emily Dickinson’s correspondence with guide Sarah Zureick-Brown, a trustee of the Amherst Historical Society and the creator of The Silent Sod. During this 75 minute tour, you’ll meet Dickinson’s local contemporaries to whom she expressed grief and solace in her letters, and you’ll also be introduced to some of Amherst’s other literary legends If you walk along the Mill River conservation trail in North Amherst today, you will see little to suggest that this small, shaded valley - situated roughly between Pine Street and Pulpit Hill Road - has changed much in the three centuries since Hadley farmers first moved into the area.
